blocks.content: We have already created a fully functional game of hangman. But it still looks dull without the graphics depicting a hanging man.
Let's add a text-based artwork to make our game more fun and interactive.
Here, we have modified the display_misses() function to draw an artwork based on the number of misses.
Notice that the figure is complete at 6 misses, which is the maximum number of misses a player can make.
Now let's complete our project by adding this feature to the main code.
